experiences.name: Vatican Museums & Sistine Chapel
experiences.description: Explore one of the world's greatest art collections, culminating in Michelangelo's breathtaking Sistine Chapel ceiling. Book skip-the-line tickets in advance to maximize your time among Renaissance masterpieces.

experiences.name: Trastevere Food Walking Tour
experiences.description: Wander through the charming cobblestone streets of Trastevere sampling supplì, artichokes alla romana, fresh pasta, and local wines at family-run trattorias and street food stalls beloved by locals.

experiences.name: Borghese Gallery Art Experience
experiences.description: Visit this intimate yet world-class gallery housing Bernini sculptures and Caravaggio paintings inside a stunning villa. Reservations are mandatory and limited, making it an exclusive and immersive art encounter.

experiences.name: Campo de' Fiori Market & Cooking Class
experiences.description: Start your morning selecting fresh seasonal ingredients at the vibrant Campo de' Fiori market, then join a hands-on cooking class nearby to learn how to prepare classic Roman dishes like cacio e pepe and tiramisu.
experiences.location: Campo de' Fiori, Centro Storico, Rome

experiences.name: Palatine Hill & Roman Forum Guided Art Walk
experiences.description: Join a small-group guided tour of the Roman Forum and Palatine Hill, uncovering ancient frescoes, mosaics, and architectural art that defined Western civilization. Includes Colosseum exterior viewing.
experiences.location: Palatine Hill & Roman Forum, Celio district, Rome
